017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.auth.saml;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.AssertionUtils.*;
020import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
021import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.StringUtils.*;
022
023import java.io.*;
024import java.nio.charset.*;
025import java.security.*;
026import java.util.*;
027
028import org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.*;
029import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.auth.*;
030
031import jakarta.servlet.http.*;
032
033/**
034 * {@link AuthFilter} that authenticates requests carrying a SAML 2.0 {@code <samlp:Response>} delivered via
035 * the {@link SamlBinding#POST} or {@link SamlBinding#REDIRECT} HTTP binding.
036 *
037 * <p>
038 * On each request this filter:
039 * <ol>
040 *    <li>Inspects the URL path against the configured {@code consumerPath} (default {@code /saml/acs}).  If the
041 *       request path does not match, returns {@link Optional#empty()} (filter does not apply).
042 *    <li>For the {@link SamlBinding#POST} binding: reads the {@code SAMLResponse} form parameter and
043 *       base64-decodes it.  For {@link SamlBinding#REDIRECT}: reads the {@code SAMLResponse} query parameter,
044 *       base64-decodes it, and then DEFLATE-inflates (RFC 1951) per OASIS SAML 2.0 Redirect binding rules.
045 *    <li>Delegates to {@link SamlAssertionValidator#validate(String)}.  On success, builds an {@link AuthResult}
046 *       carrying the resolved {@link ClaimsPrincipal}.  On failure, re-throws as an
047 *       {@link AuthenticationException} with a {@code WWW-Authenticate: SAML ...} challenge.
048 * </ol>
049 *
050 * <h5 class='topic'>Roles</h5>
051 * <p>
052 * If the resolved {@link ClaimsPrincipal} contains a claim whose name equals the configured
053 * {@code rolesClaim} (default {@code "roles"}) and whose value is a {@link List} of {@link String}, those role
054 * names are populated on the {@link AuthResult}.  Otherwise the role set is empty.
055 *
056 * <h5 class='topic'>Usage</h5>
057 *
058 * <p class='bjava'>
059 *    <jk>var</jk> validator = SamlAssertionValidator.<jsm>create</jsm>()
060 *       .metadataResolver(SamlMetadataResolvers.<jsm>url</jsm>(<js>"https://idp.example.com/metadata"</js>))
061 *       .spEntityId(<js>"https://sp.example.com"</js>)
062 *       .expectedIssuer(<js>"https://idp.example.com"</js>)
063 *       .build();
064 *
065 *    AuthFilterChain.<jsm>create</jsm>(<jv>bs</jv>)
066 *       .append(SamlAuthFilter.<jsm>create</jsm>()
067 *          .consumerPath(<js>"/saml/acs"</js>)
068 *          .binding(SamlBinding.<jsf>POST</jsf>)
069 *          .validator(<jv>validator</jv>)
070 *          .build())
071 *       .build();
072 * </p>
073 *
074 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5>
075 * <ul>
076 *    <li class='jc'>{@link SamlAssertionValidator}
077 *    <li class='jc'>{@link SamlBinding}
078 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://docs.oasis-open.org/security/saml/v2.0/saml-bindings-2.0-os.pdf">SAML 2.0 Bindings (OASIS)</a>
079 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/AuthFilterFramework">AuthN Filter Framework</a>
080 * </ul>
081 *
082 * @since 10.0.0
083 */
084@SuppressWarnings({
085   "java:S1192" // Duplicate string literals are SAML attribute names and HTTP header values; intentional
086})
087public class SamlAuthFilter extends AuthFilter {
088
089   private static final String DEFAULT_CONSUMER_PATH = "/saml/acs";
090   private static final String DEFAULT_ROLES_CLAIM = "roles";
091   private static final String SAML_RESPONSE_PARAM = "SAMLResponse";
092
093   /**
094    * Default ceiling on the number of decompressed bytes accepted from a REDIRECT-binding
095    * {@code SAMLResponse} (1 MiB).
096    */
097   public static final long DEFAULT_MAX_INFLATED_BYTES = 1L * 1024 * 1024;
098
099   /**
100    * Default ceiling on the decompressed-to-compressed size ratio accepted from a REDIRECT-binding
101    * {@code SAMLResponse}.
102    */
103   public static final int DEFAULT_MAX_INFLATE_RATIO = 100;
104
105   /**
106    * Static creator.
107    *
108    * @return A new builder.
109    */
110   public static Builder create() {
111      return new Builder();
112   }
113
114   /**
115    * Builder for {@link SamlAuthFilter}.
116    */
117   public static class Builder {
118      private SamlAssertionValidator validator;
119      private SamlBinding binding = SamlBinding.POST;
120      private String consumerPath = DEFAULT_CONSUMER_PATH;
121      private String rolesClaim = DEFAULT_ROLES_CLAIM;
122      private String realm = "saml";
123      private long maxInflatedBytes = DEFAULT_MAX_INFLATED_BYTES;
124      private int maxInflateRatio = DEFAULT_MAX_INFLATE_RATIO;
125
126      /** Constructor. */
127      protected Builder() {}
128
129      /**
130       * Sets the SAML assertion validator.
131       *
132       * @param value The validator.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
133       * @return This object.
134       */
135      public Builder validator(SamlAssertionValidator value) {
136         validator = assertArgNotNull("value", value);
137         return this;
138      }
139
140      /**
141       * Sets the SAML binding the filter listens for.  Defaults to {@link SamlBinding#POST}.
142       *
143       * @param value The binding.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
144       * @return This object.
145       */
146      public Builder binding(SamlBinding value) {
147         binding = assertArgNotNull("value", value);
148         return this;
149      }
150
151      /**
152       * Sets the request path that carries the SAML assertion.  Defaults to {@code /saml/acs}.
153       *
154       * @param value The request path.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
155       * @return This object.
156       */
157      public Builder consumerPath(String value) {
158         consumerPath = assertArgNotNullOrBlank("value", value);
159         return this;
160      }
161
162      /**
163       * Sets the claim name used to extract roles from the resolved {@link ClaimsPrincipal}.
164       *
165       * @param value The claim name.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
166       * @return This object.
167       */
168      public Builder rolesClaim(String value) {
169         rolesClaim = assertArgNotNullOrBlank("value", value);
170         return this;
171      }
172
173      /**
174       * Sets the {@code WWW-Authenticate: SAML realm="<value>"} challenge realm.
175       *
176       * @param value The realm.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
177       * @return This object.
178       */
179      public Builder realm(String value) {
180         realm = assertArgNotNullOrBlank("value", value);
181         return this;
182      }
183
184      /**
185       * Sets the ceiling on the number of decompressed bytes accepted from a {@link SamlBinding#REDIRECT}
186       * {@code SAMLResponse}.  Defaults to {@link SamlAuthFilter#DEFAULT_MAX_INFLATED_BYTES}.
187       *
188       * <p>
189       * A REDIRECT-binding {@code SAMLResponse} is DEFLATE-compressed in transit, so a small query-string
190       * payload can expand to a much larger document.  Decompression stops and the request is rejected once
191       * the running output exceeds this cap, so a highly-compressible payload cannot drive an unbounded
192       * allocation.  A value {@code <= 0} disables the absolute cap (the ratio guard still applies).
193       *
194       * @param value The maximum decompressed size in bytes.
195       * @return This object.
196       */
197      public Builder maxInflatedBytes(long value) {
198         maxInflatedBytes = value;
199         return this;
200      }
201
202      /**
203       * Sets the ceiling on the decompressed-to-compressed size ratio accepted from a
204       * {@link SamlBinding#REDIRECT} {@code SAMLResponse}.  Defaults to
205       * {@link SamlAuthFilter#DEFAULT_MAX_INFLATE_RATIO}.
206       *
207       * <p>
208       * This guard catches a highly-compressible payload even when the absolute
209       * {@link #maxInflatedBytes(long) byte cap} is generous.  A value {@code <= 0} disables the ratio guard.
210       *
211       * @param value The maximum output-to-input ratio.
212       * @return This object.
213       */
214      public Builder maxInflateRatio(int value) {
215         maxInflateRatio = value;
216         return this;
217      }
218
219      /**
220       * Builds the filter.
221       *
222       * @return A new {@link SamlAuthFilter}.
223       */
224      public SamlAuthFilter build() {
225         if (validator == null)
226            throw new IllegalStateException("SamlAuthFilter requires a SamlAssertionValidator");
227         return new SamlAuthFilter(this);
228      }
229   }
230
231   private final SamlAssertionValidator validator;
232   private final SamlBinding binding;
233   private final String consumerPath;
234   private final String rolesClaim;
235   private final String challenge;
236   private final long maxInflatedBytes;
237   private final int maxInflateRatio;
238
239   /**
240    * Constructor.
241    *
242    * @param b The builder to read configuration from.
243    */
244   protected SamlAuthFilter(Builder b) {
245      this.validator = b.validator;
246      this.binding = b.binding;
247      this.consumerPath = b.consumerPath;
248      this.rolesClaim = b.rolesClaim;
249      this.challenge = "SAML realm=\"" + b.realm + "\"";
250      this.maxInflatedBytes = b.maxInflatedBytes;
251      this.maxInflateRatio = b.maxInflateRatio;
252   }
253
254   @Override /* Overridden from AuthFilter */
255   public Optional<AuthResult> authenticate(HttpServletRequest req) throws AuthenticationException {
256      if (!matchesPath(req))
257         return oe();
258      var raw = req.getParameter(SAML_RESPONSE_PARAM);
259      if (isEmpty(raw))
260         return oe();
261      var xml = decodeSamlResponse(raw);
262      var principal = runValidator(xml);
263      return o(AuthResult.of(principal, extractRoles(principal)));
264   }
265
266   private boolean matchesPath(HttpServletRequest req) {
267      var p = req.getPathInfo();
268      var s = p != null ? p : req.getServletPath();
269      return s != null && s.equals(consumerPath);
270   }
271
272   private String decodeSamlResponse(String raw) throws AuthenticationException {
273      try {
274         byte[] decoded = Base64.getMimeDecoder().decode(raw);
275         return switch (binding) {
276            // Per SAML 2.0 Redirect binding: raw DEFLATE (no zlib wrapper), decompressed under a hard
277            // output-size cap and ratio guard so a compressible payload cannot force an unbounded allocation.
278            case REDIRECT -> new String(IoUtils.inflate(decoded, true, maxInflatedBytes, maxInflateRatio), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
279            // Per SAML 2.0 POST binding: the base64-decoded bytes are the raw XML document.
280            case POST -> new String(decoded, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
281         };
282      } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
283         throw new AuthenticationException(e, "SAMLResponse parameter is not valid base64")
284            .wwwAuthenticate(challenge);
285      } catch (IOException e) {
286         throw new AuthenticationException(e, "SAMLResponse parameter could not be inflated (REDIRECT binding)")
287            .wwwAuthenticate(challenge);
288      }
289   }
290
291   private Principal runValidator(String xml) throws AuthenticationException {
292      try {
293         var p = validator.validate(xml);
294         if (p == null)
295            throw new AuthenticationException("SAML validator returned null").wwwAuthenticate(challenge);
296         return p;
297      } catch (AuthenticationException e) {
298         var hasChallenge = e.getHeaders().stream()
299            .anyMatch(h -> "WWW-Authenticate".equalsIgnoreCase(h.getName()));
300         if (!hasChallenge)
301            e.wwwAuthenticate(challenge);
302         throw e;
303      } catch (RuntimeException e) {
304         throw new AuthenticationException(e, "SAML validation failed").wwwAuthenticate(challenge);
305      }
306   }
307
308   @SuppressWarnings({
309      "unchecked" // Type erasure on reflective/generic cast; element type is verified at call site
310   })
311   private Set<String> extractRoles(Principal principal) {
312      if (principal instanceof ClaimsPrincipal principal2) {
313         var v = principal2.getClaims().get(rolesClaim);
314         if (v instanceof List<?> v2) {
315            var roles = new HashSet<String>();
316            for (var item : (List<Object>) v2)
317               if (item instanceof String item2)
318                  roles.add(item2);
319            return roles;
320         }
321      }
322      return Collections.emptySet();
323   }
324}
